031    public void duplicateStudentNamesReturnSameId() throws Exception {
032        int a = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateStudent("Dup Student");
033        int b = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateStudent("Dup Student");
034        assertEquals(a, b, "Duplicate student names should return the same id");
035    }

037    @Test
038    /**
039     * ensureAssessmentPartsIsIdempotentAndIgnoresUnknownPartsOnInsert - TODO: describe this method
040     */
041
042    public void ensureAssessmentPartsIsIdempotentAndIgnoresUnknownPartsOnInsert() throws Exception {
043        int pt = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateProgressType("EdgeType");
044        String[] parts = new String[] {"X1","X2","X3"};
045        com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.ensureAssessmentParts(pt, parts);
046        // calling again should not fail and should be idempotent
047        com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.ensureAssessmentParts(pt, parts);
048
049        int sid = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateStudent("Edge Student");
050        int session = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.createProgressSession(sid, pt, LocalDate.now());
051        // insert with an unknown part code - should be ignored, no exception
052        com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.insertAssessmentResults(session, pt, new String[] {"X1","UNKNOWN"}, new int[] {5, 9});
053
054        List<List<Integer>> rows = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.fetchLatestAssessmentResults("Edge Student", "EdgeType", 5);
055        assertNotNull(rows);
056        assertTrue(rows.size() >= 1);
057    }
058

064    public void saveSessionNotesPersistsNotes() throws Exception {
065        int pt = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateProgressType("NoteType");
066        int sid = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateStudent("Notes Student");
067        int session = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.createProgressSession(sid, pt, LocalDate.now());
068        com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.saveSessionNotes(session, "These are test notes");
069
070        List<List<Integer>> rows = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.fetchLatestAssessmentResults("Notes Student", "NoteType", 5);
071        // fetchLatestAssessmentResults doesn't return notes, but we can at least ensure the session exists by getting session rows
072        assertNotNull(rows);
073    }
